name: chrome
description: Control Chrome through a plugin-bundled persistent Node REPL, Chrome extension, and Native Messaging host.

shortDescription.en-US: Use Chrome through a persistent Node REPL.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过持久 Node REPL 使用 Chrome。

longDescription.en-US: A self-contained Chrome plugin that exposes a persistent Node REPL with a preloaded Chrome browser runtime, built Chrome extension, and platform-specific Rust Native Messaging Host.
longDescription.zh-CN: 一个自包含的 Chrome 插件，通过持久 Node REPL 暴露预加载的 Chrome 浏览器运行时，并内含构建后的 Chrome 扩展和平台对应的 Rust Native Messaging Host。

mcpServers.name: Chrome Node REPL
mcpServers.description: Run JavaScript in a persistent local Node.js REPL with a preloaded Chrome browser runtime.

tools.name: js
tools.title: Chrome Node REPL JavaScript
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a persistent Node.js REPL with Chrome runtime helpers.

tools.name: js_reset

tools.description: Reset the persistent Node.js REPL state.

tools.name: js_add_node_module_dir
tools.title: Add Node Module Directory
tools.description: Add a node_modules directory to CommonJS module resolution.

permissions: Runs JavaScript requested by the agent in a persistent local process, including local module, filesystem, and network access.
Reads and controls Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension, including navigation, page inspection, screenshots, clicks, scrolling, typing, and form filling.
Allows raw page JavaScript and Chrome DevTools Protocol commands through the preloaded browser runtime.
Registers and runs the plugin-bundled Native Messaging Host for the current user.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be installed, enabled, and connected.
installReview: Runs a persistent local JavaScript process bundled inside the Chrome plugin.
JavaScript can load local modules and access the local filesystem and network.
Browser interaction, raw page script, and Chrome DevTools Protocol access run through the JavaScript tool and are configured to ask before execution.
Registers a user-level Chrome Native Messaging Host whose executable is bundled inside the plugin.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be connected before browser commands can run.

skillPreviews.name: Chrome
skillPreviews.description: Control the user's Chrome browser through a persistent Node REPL when tasks depend on existing tabs, signed-in sessions, extensions, visible page state, or UI interaction.
